[DRAFT — Janco/Chloe: please review. This is a sensible starting point, not legal advice.]

**Who we are.** Nails by Chloe is a mobile nail service run by Chloe in Roodepoort, Gauteng. In this notice "I" and "me" means Chloe.

**What I collect.** When you send a booking request, the details you type (your name, WhatsApp number, optional email, the service and design you want, your preferred date and area, and any notes) are put into a WhatsApp message that you send to me yourself. If email notifications are switched on, a copy of the same details is emailed to me. This website does not store your details in a database.

**Why I collect it.** Only to arrange and carry out your appointment, and to contact you about it.

**Your address.** I only ask for your full address on WhatsApp after I have confirmed your booking.

**Sharing.** I do not sell or share your details with anyone. WhatsApp (Meta) and, if used, my email provider process the messages you send me under their own privacy policies.

**How long I keep it.** I keep booking messages only as long as I need them for your appointments and my basic business records.

**Your rights (POPIA).** You can ask me what information I have about you, ask me to correct it, or ask me to delete it at any time. Just send me a WhatsApp or email.

**Website analytics.** This site may use privacy-friendly, cookie-free analytics that counts page views without identifying you. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

**Contact.** WhatsApp or email me using the details on the Contact page.

[DRAFT — Janco/Chloe: please review. This is a sensible starting point, not legal advice.]

**Booking requests.** Sending a request through this site does not confirm a booking. Your appointment is confirmed only once I reply on WhatsApp.

**Prices.** Prices on this site are starting prices. The final price depends on your design, colour availability and travel distance, and I will confirm it with you before your appointment.

**Deposits.** Some bookings need a deposit. If so, I'll send the details on WhatsApp. Deposits come off the final price.

**Cancellations.** Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations and no-shows may lose the deposit.

**Running late.** Very late starts may mean a simpler design so the next client is not kept waiting.

**Aftercare and fixes.** If a nail lifts or breaks within 3 days because of my work, let me know and I'll fix it free of charge. Damage from accidents or using nails as tools isn't covered.

**Health.** Please tell me about any allergies, infections or nail conditions before your appointment. I may decline to work on nails that are infected or damaged, for your safety.
